limitations: The TriggerData XML root is the declarative prefilter because valid SC2 trigger documents may be extensionless or use several weak extensions; the bounded detector verifies Library, Root, and Element structure.
Browser hosts can use the bounded detector, but the current Trigger/Galaxy conversion runtime reaches Node-only dependencies.
Trigger-to-Galaxy conversion works without NativeLib using documented fallbacks; round-trip comparison requires an injected NativeLib and is not an unconditional manifest operation.

The edit capability covers catalog gamelink/abilcmd rename only, as a text splice that preserves surrounding formatting; ids spelled as raw string literals inside custom ScriptCode blocks are not patched. It requires an injected coordinating catalog because a trigger document cannot confirm the renamed entities exist or that the catalog half of the rename was applied, so edit.content is not an unconditional manifest operation.
Completion, formatting, identifier-level refactoring, and compilation are unavailable; compilation and execution belong to the separately permissioned sc2-runtime codec.
StarCraft II game contribution metadata remains on the semantic codec until game manifests land in Slice C3.
